tasks.label: Fly to the grey refrigerator
tasks.prompt: The view starts in a narrow office lounge corridor with glass partitions, looking toward a grey refrigerator at the far end. Large blue water jugs sit on the floor to the left, while a long grey sofa with orange cushions lines the right wall. The camera pushes steadily forward down the center of the aisle. As the viewpoint advances, the water jugs and sofa expand outward toward the frame edges, and the refrigerator grows significantly larger in the center. The sequence ends with a close-up view where the refrigerator dominates the central third of the frame.

tasks.label: Fly to the standing fan
tasks.prompt: The scene opens in a spacious industrial room with gray flooring, heavy curtains, and a standing fan on the left. The camera pushes forward and drifts slightly to the left, targeting the fan. As the viewpoint advances, the fan grows significantly larger and shifts from the left third toward the center, while the person at the desk in the background slides toward the right side of the frame. The sequence concludes with the fan framed centrally as the main subject, appearing much closer than in the initial view.

tasks.label: Fly to the white column

As the viewpoint advances, the column shifts from the center-right region toward the central third of the frame and grows larger, while the robot slides toward the left edge. The sequence settles into a closer view with the white column clearly framed as the main target in the central third.

tasks.label: Fly to the window

tasks.label: Fly to the recycling bins

The sequence settles into a closer view where the recycling bins are clearly framed as the main target in the central third.

The sequence settles into a closer left-offset view with the black car clearly framed as the main target.
